generation_review.full_prompt:
Create exactly ONE new original Small Seal script glyph based on the attached four-specimen Unicode reference. THX, CCZ, QJZ and DYC are all variants of THE SAME ONE CHARACTER, not separate output characters. Compare ALL available specimens equally to understand the exact identity. Choose ONE coherent attested WHOLE construction if variants differ; never splice incompatible alternatives or default to THX alone. Do not substitute a modern Chinese character.

Trace genuine writing-stroke trajectories as smooth controlled centerline curves. Draw these with exactly CONSTANT uniform thickness approximately 3% of the square canvas width, perfectly rounded caps and joins. No swelling, taper, pointed tips, brush pressure, serif, texture or outline of brush silhouettes. Keep essential branches, short marks, counters, attachments, separations and relative bar lengths explicit. Important small gaps must stay open.

ONE finished glyph centered in the central 70% of a square canvas with generous clear margins. Pure BLACK strokes on fully TRANSPARENT background. No text, labels, charts, grids, frame, four variants, reference copies, shadows, paper, backdrop, ornament or watermark. The structural reading aid below guides attention, while all four reference specimens remain the visual authority.

CHARACTER U+3D04C. Detailed reading aid: Compare allfour and choose coherent THX open/detached WHOLE form. UPPER LEFT: TWO separate bent/curving strokes, stacked: a small upper open hook curving from upper-left toward right then back down-left, and a larger lower open hook which curves up-right then descends a long sweep toward lower-left. Keep these2separate, not merged into one long vertical. UPPER CENTER: one tall central upright, short apex/roof branches sloping downLEFT andRIGHT near its top, then a distinct horizontal crossbar below roof. Below crossbar, a SHORT right-facing branch runs from central stem toRIGHT then turnsUP to a free endpoint; keep this tip detached from crossbar, not a closed box. At base of this upper central unit, a separate L-shaped course starts with a short left upright free endpoint, curvesDOWN then runsRIGHT as a floor through/joining central stem. Its right floor end is free. Upper central unit has NOcounter in this chosen open construction. UPPER RIGHT: one P-like loop with exactlyONEcounter on its upper-right and a short upper-left overhang; from the loop's lower-left side, one continuous S-curved tail bendsLEFT thenRIGHT and ends downward at upper group's lower-right. KeepthisP/tailseparatefromuppercentralunit. BELOW entire upper group: a detached SHORT horizontal, then a muchLONGERhorizontal joined to a central long descending stem. Two curved detached flankdescenders beneath longbar yield exactlyTHREE lower ends. Keep shortbar and uppergroup detached fromlongbar; Ptaildoesnotextendtooverallbaseline. TotalONEcounter, insideupper-rightPloop. Do not import DYCclosedcentralbox or QJZjoinedleftstrokes.
Useoneconsistent2.8%canvas stroke withvisibleopengaps around the upper central shortupturnedbranch.
